description: Archived per-shot VEST operational history, one row per shot 38000-45767 (2257 shots). A historical legacy-pipeline sheet, NOT a vaft.database.summary(preset='shot_overview') result.
distribution: repository-only (not in the wheel or sdist)

provenance.generator: workflow/automatic_pipeline_3_data_summary/gen_omas_history.py as of commit 458a42285 (2025-10-17); the current script is a later rewrite with different columns
provenance.source_namespace: legacy public FileDB (/srv/vest.filedb/public/<shot>/), not HSDS main

columns.plasma_onset_time: ms; breakdown onset from spectrometer_uv channel 0 (H-alpha) crossing 5 % of its peak
columns.pulse_duration: ms; offset minus onset of the same H-alpha signal (5 % threshold)
columns.max_plasma_current: kA; maximum of the median-filtered (kernel 15) magnetics.ip
columns.toroidal_field: T; mean vacuum toroidal field at R = 0.4 m between H-alpha onset and offset
columns.efit_kfile_count: count of legacy EFIT k-files in the shot directory
columns.chease_gfile_count: count of CHEASE g-files (0 for every row)

limitations: No pulse date: pulse_time_begin is not recorded, so history is by shot number only.
No shot_class, plasma_onset_source or pulse_duty_cycle; every shot has finite values, so failed or vacuum shots appear with near-zero current rather than as a class.
Onset and duration use the H-alpha 5 % threshold of the legacy script, not vaft.omas.plasma_timing.
Values were computed by an obsolete pipeline and are not regenerated here.
